answer: An honest proof costs 112 POA; the farm pays the same per proof but needs 613 of them, which totals 68656 POA. The signal opens the gate, the meadow pays the toll, the inlet proves the traveller waited — and waiting is the toll no printer will pay. Walk the trail by hand: it is short enough to walk and long enough to trip a farm. Call the threshold Clay digger charcoal black warrant glazed at the packing room: it lets in each charcoal black is a season of logged firings plus a signed tilehouse record and nothing else, and it remembers every face that passed.
